data.name: Hammaad
data.gender_notes: Hammaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who assists and supports. In Arabic, the name Hammaad is derived from the Arabic word 'hamid', meaning 'praised', 'lauded' or 'to praise'. The name Hammaad, therefore, signifies a supporter, helper or one who assists and praises. The name Hammaad carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hammaad usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is generous and selfless
data.etymology: Hammaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hammaad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حماد
in_arabic.meaning: حسن الخلق، محمود الصفات، ذو الحمد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: حسن الخلق، محمود الصفات، ذو الحمد، ومشتق من الحمد الذي هو ضد الذم، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَشَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَمِيدُ'

in_urdu.name: حماد
in_urdu.meaning: اچھی صفات والا، قابل ستایش، حمید
in_urdu.long_meaning: حماد ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے اچھی صفات والا، قابل ستایش، حمید۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ حمید (اللہ کی صفت) سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हम्माद
in_hindi.long_meaning: हम्माद एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है अच्छे गुणों वाला, प्रशंसनीय, हमीद। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह हमीद (अल्लाह की विशेषता) से लिया गया है, जिसका उल्लेख कुरआन में किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: حماد
in_pashto.meaning: د ښو صفاتو لرونکی، ستایښی، حمید
in_pashto.long_meaning: حماد د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې نه اخیستی دی، او دے مطلب یی د ښو صفاتو لرونکی، ستایښی، حمید دی. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په کی د مهمو نومونو څخه ګڼل کیږي ځکه چی دا د حمید (الله تعالیٰ د صفت) نه مشتق شوی دی، کوم چی په قرآن کریم کی ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Hammaad
in_english.long_meaning: Hammaad is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning good-natured, praiseworthy, and derived from Hamid, which is one of the attributes of Allah in Islam. The name has a rich history and is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes positive qualities such as kindness, compassion, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hammaad holds significant cultural significance in Islamic communities, as it represents a selfless and supportive nature. In various Islamic traditions, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is known to have emphasized the importance of helping and supporting one another. The name Hammaad reflects these values and is considered an admirable and noble name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hammaad signifies a deep connection and commitment to supporting and assisting others. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." (Bukhari). The name Hammaad, therefore, encourages individuals to be strong in their character, help and support those in need, and maintain self-control in times of anger.
